continuity: Ma Sanbao is a central figure in a covert faction formed by survivors of the imperial capital’s earlier bloodshed; they have signed a pact to overthrow the Emperor.
Ma Sanbao and the Grand Secretary expect the Emperor’s announced banquet to become the point of confrontation between the factions.
Ma Sanbao says the person his allies asked about is safe and that the young martial artist will help their faction; he believes the martial artist’s master could be decisive.
plot: Ma Sanbao meets secretly with a dozen allies, using his disguise technique and Bone-Shrinking Technique to enter unnoticed. The group, made up of survivors of the earlier bloodshed and the faction they built in secret, signs a pact to overthrow the Emperor. Ma warns that the Emperor may be planning another purge and agrees with the Grand Secretary that the Emperor’s banquet is likely to bring the factions into open conflict.

Ma reassures the allies that they have sufficient grounds and strength for their undertaking, while withholding details of their preparations. He says the person they asked about is safe and predicts the young martial artist will help them; the martial artist’s master, he says, could change the balance.
translation_decisions: Render 연판장 as “a pact bearing their signatures” in this chapter.

active_continuity: The Emperor has confirmed the rumors about Prince Shangshan’s return and the existence of an heir; whether Aehyang is pregnant remains unconfirmed.
The Emperor has confined Prince Shangshan in Qianqing Palace; Taekyung returned without him.
The Emperor plans a banquet attended by Shangshan and civil and military officials; Hong Jin suspects it could be a trap.
Ma Sanbao spread the rumors using information Jin Taekyung gave him; the Emperor ordered the arrested rumor-spreaders released.
Ma Sanbao is a central figure in a covert faction of survivors seeking to overthrow the Emperor; they have signed a pact.
Ma Sanbao and the Grand Secretary expect the Emperor’s banquet to become the point of confrontation.
Ma Sanbao says the person his allies asked about is safe and expects the young martial artist to help; he believes the martial artist’s master could be decisive.
Taekyung suspects the Emperor is connected to Dark Heaven, but this is unconfirmed.
The late Emperor died after a period of mental confusion while confined; Taekyung suspects Blood Soul Gu may have been involved, but this is unconfirmed.
The City Lord of Sichuan Province showed strange symptoms before his death, and Blood Soul Gu was found in his corpse.
Jeok Cheongang received two letters, burned them, and said the group was formally invited to the imperial palace; their contents and the invitation’s purpose remain unknown.
open_questions: Is Aehyang pregnant, and what does the Emperor intend for her and Shangshan?
Will the banquet become a confrontation, and what does the Emperor intend?
Did the Emperor or Dark Heaven use Blood Soul Gu against the late Emperor and the City Lord of Sichuan Province?
Who is the person Ma Sanbao’s allies asked about, and what preparations has the faction made?
Will the Myriad-Poison Ring protect Shangshan from Blood Soul Gu?
temporary_decisions: Render 기관진식 as “mechanisms and formations”; retain “Third Shadow,” “First Shadow,” “No Shadow,” and “Marquis Within the Passes.”
Use “imugi,” not “dragon,” for the creature Taekyung killed at Dongting Lake.
Render 연판장 as “a pact bearing their signatures” in Chapter 881; retain “Hongmen Banquet” for 홍문연.
